collection.description: A proposed village meeting conflicts with feeding, rest, and caregiving routines for several families.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A proposed village meeting conflicts with feeding, rest, and caregiving routines for several families.

choices.label: Ask Nursing Mothers and Other Caregivers First
Invite Teens to Help with Logistics
Invite Elders to Advise on Precedent

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The meeting moves to a more accessible time without treating their needs as an inconvenience.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Caregivers suggest an optional nearby quiet area and flexible participation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Teens organize seating and supplies while retaining time for their own commitments.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (teen) points out that caregiving is not automatically their responsibility.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children request a safe play space within sight of trusted adults.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Older children prefer to attend part of the discussion and ask thoughtful questions.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) remembers when meetings rotated through neighborhoods.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Another elder admits the old schedule excluded many villagers and supports changing it.
